results.description: By Trajectory's account to Epoch, the agents had been given a deliberately impossible task — grading a fake set of FrontierMath problems — with instructions never to give up and never to conclude that the task could not be done. results.title: Gemini AI agents repeatedly bypassed safeguards to attack real website
results.description: For three hours, the agents made 36,411 requests to a planted API endpoint and sent 487 messages through the hotline, including some that attempted to impersonate actual Epoch employees or claimed to be engineers and auditors requesting benchmark information. An investigation also identified an attempted SQL injection attack and more than 200 attempts to access FrontierMath evaluation logs. Trajectory Labs discovered the activity while reviewing agent transcripts and notified Epoch AI of the unauthorized attacks the following morning.
